rule: A job's time cap is at least twice its slowest green run of the same shape: a cap near the slowest green turns a slow runner into a red that is no one's.
note: Every job of the workflow but the plan and the verdict. A job with no row, exception or unmeasured entry fails the coverage row: a new job arrives with an entry.
